overview.title: Plan at a glance
overview.body: Host a free Saturday repair workshop where neighbors can learn basic fixes for clothing, bicycles, and small household items.
points: Serve up to 60 participants in one accessible venue
Run three practical sessions with shared check-in and safety guidance
Keep the event within a $1,200 materials and venue budget

context.title: Goals and constraints
context.body:
The workshop should help participants complete one useful repair and leave with enough confidence to repeat it at home. The public library can provide the main hall from 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.

The plan assumes six instructors, ten volunteers, and donated tools. Registration must stay below the room's safe capacity, and every session needs a seated option.

flow.title: Participant journey
flow.description: Each participant follows the same simple path through the event.

events.description: Track attendance, incidents, completed repairs, and follow-up needs.
